serp_features.text:
![Orthodox Weddings are a community celebration - Stellar Visions](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11020612-2247-0139-0000-ce54546b2722:4)
Macedonian weddings are multi-day celebrations filled with `rich Orthodox religious rites, lively folk music, and symbolic household traditions`.[[1]](https://www.macedoniancathedral.org/wedding-ceremonies)[[2]](https://www.tiktok.com/@macedoniangifts/video/7652531371495279893)

### Pre-Wedding Customs

- **Groom Shaving:** On the wedding morning, friends and family humorously "shave" the groom using blunt items like axes or wooden swords.
- **Buying the Bride:** The groomsmen and family bargain and play games with the bride's family at her home before she is handed over.
- **Filling the Shoes:** During the bride retrieval, the best man or brother-in-law symbolically fills the bride’s oversized shoes with cash until they "fit" her properly.
- **Dumping Water:** As the bride leaves her family home, she kicks over a bowl or glass of water so that her new life flows smoothly.[[1]](https://www.iklektikink.com/copy-of-croatian-wedding-traditions)[[2]](https://weddedwonderland.com/7-exciting-and-unusual-things-to-expect-at-a-macedonian-wedding)[[3]](https://www.macedoniancuisine.com/2016/09/macedonian-wedding-customs.html)[[4]](https://www.tiktok.com/@onthedaysocials/video/7587324540947156242)
